bundle.description: Raw byte budget for the homepage-critical web bundle (index-*.js + __common-*.js from `expo export --platform web`). Baseline captured 2026-07-13 post-phase-2 (#4407/#4408/#4409). Bump budgetRawBytes/warnRawBytes only as an explicit, reviewed change alongside a note on why the bundle grew. 2026-09-07: bumped 5,141,545 → 5,300,000 as a stop-gap while the CI gate was dead (PR Merger merged Roadie PRs before the gate ran — see .agents/pr-merger/merge.sh GATE_CHECKS) and main had drifted to 5,226,496 unnoticed; cause was data/studies/index.js imported statically from App.js, pulling all four studies datasets (~200KB raw) into index-*.js just to compute cross-links. 2026-09-07 (#7150): restored to 5,141,545/4,907,839 now that App.js imports a small generated membership index (data/studies/membershipIndex.js, precomputed by scripts/compute-studies.cjs) instead of data/studies/index.js, and the four *BrandPage components + data/studies/index.js itself get their rank/headline numbers from that same small index rather than the full datasets - the full datasets are now reachable only from each /studies page's own already-lazy chunk.

homepageRequestGraph.description: Chunk names that must never be requested on initial homepage load. These are explicitly deferred behind scroll (IntersectionObserver) in TopListsSection/AlbumArticlesSection (#4407) because of their size (albumArticles ~10MB raw, top10Lists ~830KB raw). Other lazy chunks (SoundLikeGuides, drummerComparisons, etc.) are intentionally preloaded in the background via requestIdleCallback for fast subsequent navigation and are not covered by this check.
